note: 00 53 70 is the descriptor prefix plus smallulong 112, which the generated surface gives the header type; c0 04 02 is list8 with size 4 (the count octet plus three data octets) and count 2; 41 is boolean true (durable) and 50 05 is ubyte 5 (priority). Hand-derived from the field order the artifact declares for header (durable, priority, ttl, first-acquirer, delivery-count) and Part 1's list encoding, so it pins that a section's body is read in the declared field order.

All five declared header fields, written in declared order: 41 durable true, 50 09 priority 9, 70 0000ea60 ttl as uint32 60000 (its declared type is milliseconds, which the table restricts to uint), 42 first-acquirer false, 52 01 delivery-count 1 as smalluint. Size 0x0c is the count octet plus eleven data octets.

user-id is field 2 and subject is field 4 of properties, so the two absent fields before each are carried as nulls: 40, a0 02 beef (binary), 40, a1 02 6869 (string). This is what the declared field order costs a sender, and why a reader must not compact the list.
The same rule from the writer's side: subject is field 4, so three nulls precede it. Trailing absent fields are omitted, which is why nothing follows the string.

data restricts binary, and a0 00 is vbin8 with a zero-octet length, which is how an empty payload is written: the declared surface has no zero-octet binary form, so the section is five octets rather than three and 40 would be null rather than an empty binary. The boundary matters because a writer must be able to state an empty body rather than omit the section.
A short payload in the eight-bit variable form, a0 02 6869, which is the narrowest form the declared surface offers for two octets.

amqp-sequence restricts list, so its body is a compound rather than a binary. Each element is an int written in the four-octet form (71, not the one-octet smallint 54): the specification's writer reads smallint but never writes it, because the corpus's canonical vectors fix an int to its own width.

amqp-value restricts the wildcard type, so its body is one value of any type; here a string. This is the section a payload-carried composite arrives in, so its read path is what the transaction layer dispatches on.
The same section carrying a symbol instead: the wildcard means the reader cannot decide the body's type from the section, only from the value's own constructor, a3 04 616d7170.

footer restricts annotations, which restricts map: its body is a compound of pairs, not a list of fields. c1 0b 02 is map8 with size 11 and a count of two items, a3 07 78 2d 6f 70 74 2d 6b is the x-opt-k symbol key and 40 the null value. The key is an x-opt one on purpose: a footer whose key is a reserved symbol the endpoint does not implement is refused, which sec-neg-footer-reserved-key pins. The count counts items, two per pair, which is why one pair declares two.

An annotation whose symbolic key begins with x-opt- is one the receiver may not understand: the clause says such keys MUST be ignored if not understood, so this vector is admitted with an empty policy. a3 09 78 2d 6f 70 74 2d 6b 65 79 is the symbol x-opt-key (its tag, its one-octet length and nine octets) and 41 the boolean value.
The same rule for message-annotations, with a string value: a3 07 78 2d 6f 70 74 2d 61 is the symbol x-opt-a (its tag, its one-octet length and seven octets) and a1 01 76 the string v.

All ulong keys are reserved, so a ulong key the receiver does not implement is a key it does not understand, and the clause mandates a detach for those unless the key begins with x-opt. The policy is the endpoint's knowledge made an explicit input rather than a hidden decision: here it names key 1, so 53 01 (smallulong 1) is understood and the section is admitted. Its twin in sections-negative.ndjson carries the same octets with an empty policy and is refused.

The reserved symbolic key rejected is defined by the artifact for error information about rejected messages, and its values MUST be of type error. The policy names it, so the section is read as an understood annotation rather than refused: a3 08 72656a6563746564 is the symbol rejected, and the value is the error composite 00 53 1d c0 04 01 a3 01 61, whose only field is a mandatory symbol condition.

application-properties restricts map, and its own text restricts the keys to strings and the values to simple types: a1 05 63 6f 6c 6f 72 is the string key color and a1 03 72 65 64 the string value red, both in the eight-bit variable form the declared surface gives a string. No annotation policy applies here, which is the difference between this section and the three annotations-sourced ones.

The same header descriptor in the eight-octet ulong form: 00 80 0000000000000070 is the descriptor prefix, the wide constructor and 112. A reader must accept both descriptor forms or it refuses a conforming sender's octets; the vector is not canonical because this specification writes the narrow form, which sec-header-encode-empty pins.

An empty header, which is what a sender writes when every field takes its declared default: the section is still present, because omitting it is a different statement from carrying an empty one and an intermediary MUST NOT insert or remove it. 45 is list0.
